thread:
jordan: heads up — CI turned red on main after the last merge. looks related to pre-commit hooks failing in the lint stage. failing job: `format-and-type-check` :sos:

maya: saw that too. error in CI log shows both `rustfmt` and `pyright` errors, which is odd — repo only touched python change in the PR.

devon: can you paste the failing snippet? I can kick a rerun but we should bisect if it repros locally.

jordan: pasted from CI (truncated):
```
+ pre-commit run --all-files
Trim trailing whitespace.................................................Failed
- hook id: trailing-whitespace
- files were modified by this hook
pyright..................................................................Failed
- hook id: pyright
- stderr:
  ERROR: /workspace/internal/typing/compat.py:12:5 - Type check failed: Argument of type "Optional[str]" is not assignable to parameter of type "str"
rustfmt..................................................................Failed
- hook id: rustfmt
- stdout: Diff in src/server/lib.rs
```

samir: hmm — `trailing-whitespace` modified files which can change formatting and then rustfmt sees diffs. pyright failure seems like a strictness bump (Optional vs str). anyone changed pyright config or `pyrightconfig.json`?

maya: i did not touch configs in that PR, only a tiny python helper. but the bot that updates dependency snapshots ran yesterday and there was a commit bumping dev-deps. wondering if pyright pinned version changed.

devon: @ci-bot can you show the CI env + pre-commit versions used in the failing job?

ci-bot: Sure — job `format-and-type-check` on runner `ubuntu-22.04`
- pre-commit: 2.22.0
- pyright (hook): pyright@1.1.313
- rustfmt: 1.5.1
- python: 3.11.6
- commit: 1a2b3c4d (merge PR #612)

jordan: thanks. that pyright version looks newer than our last green run (we were on 1.1.280-ish). if the hook bumped, that could explain stricter checks.

maya: local repro steps I ran: `poetry run pre-commit run --all-files` — same pyright error locally when using pyright@1.1.313. if I pin the hook to 1.1.280 in `.pre-commit-config.yaml` and run again, it passes.

devon: ok so two things: (1) trailing-whitespace modifying files triggers rustfmt diff — blame for that is file EOLs or trailing spaces from earlier merge, (2) pyright strictness bump failing new check.

jordan: can someone do a quick bisect to find the first commit that introduced the pyright bump or config change? if it's from the auto-update bot, revert the bot commit.

samir: i can run a quick bisect on main. plan: run `git bisect start HEAD 1a2b3c4d~10 -- pre-commit run --all-files` and check fail/pass. will post results.

maya: while samir bisects, i can open a tiny follow-up to normalize EOL and run `git add -A` then `pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure` to avoid rustfmt spurious diffs.

ci-bot: Requested: rerun of `format-and-type-check` on commit 1a2b3c4d triggered by @devon — queued.

devon: fyi if we need an emergency patch, we can pin pyright hook to previous version and revert the auto-update bot commit. but would prefer to understand the real type issue — maybe our code needs a small Optional guard.

samir: bisect update — found first bad commit: `2026-03-11 09:04:12 auto-deps-bot: bump pyright hook to 1.1.313` (commit b7f9e2). marking as culprit.

jordan: perfect, please revert that bot commit and open a follow-up to fix true type issues? also add a changelog note for the bot so future bumps are staged.

maya: reverting now and kicking a CI run. PR incoming: `revert: bump pyright hook`

ci-bot: Rerun result: `format-and-type-check` — PASSED (after revert).

devon: nice. action items: 1) add canary job that runs pyright with the new version against a small subset (prompted by bot) before auto-merge; 2) follow up to fix the Optional issue in compat.py so we can upgrade; 3) normalize repo EOLs and add ci guard to run `pre-commit --all-files` in a deterministic env.

jordan: agree. thanks everyone for the quick triage. :thumbsup:

maya: I'll file the follow-ups and link them here.

samir: done — issues: RD-INF-1423 (canary pyright job), RD-INF-1424 (fix Optional guard), RD-INF-1425 (eol / pre-commit determinism).

jordan: closing the thread — re-open if CI flaps again. :eyes:
